title: Friends
subtitle: Other MossyDew gardeners you grow alongside.
emptyHint: Send an invitation link to someone who uses MossyDew.
removeMessage: You will no longer see each other’s progress. A new invitation can bring you back together.
removed: {name} is no longer in your friends.

invite.title: Invite a friend
invite.intro: Create a link and send it to someone with a mossyleaf account. It works once, for 7 days. Friends see each other’s level, XP, streak and herbarium size, never their tasks.

join.title: Friend invitation
join.intro: {name} invites you to be friends on MossyDew. You will see each other’s level, XP, streak and herbarium size, never your tasks.

goals.title: Shared goals
goals.name: Goal
goals.empty: Set a number of tasks to complete together before a date. Every task any member completes counts, and when you get there, everyone gets a new moss and dew.
goals.needFriends: Invite a friend first to share a goal.
goals.leaveMessage: Your tasks stop counting for this goal. The others keep going without you.
goals.reachedToast: Shared goal reached: “{title}”! Everyone gets a new moss and dew.
